title.ko: 초점 구문: It was ... that · What ... is · The reason why ... is · All I did was
title.en: focus structures: It was ... that, What ... is, The reason why ... is, All I did was

explain.ko: 분열문은 문장의 한 요소를 강조하는 구문입니다. It was + 강조할 요소 + that ... 은 주어, 목적어, 부사구를 두루 강조하고, What + 절 + is ... 같은 의사분열문은 핵심 내용을 뒤로 돌려 청중의 기대를 높입니다. All I did was ...는 자신의 행동을 축소하며, The reason ... is that ...은 이유를 강조합니다. 이런 구문은 연설, 논설, 면접에서 강력한 효과를 냅니다.
explain.en: Cleft sentences emphasise one element of a sentence. It was + element + that ... can highlight a subject, object or adverbial, while pseudo-clefts such as What + clause + is ... delay the core content to raise expectation. All I did was ... minimises your own action, and The reason ... is that ... stresses a reason. These structures are powerful in speeches, editorials and interviews.

notes.en: In It was ... that, the focused element comes first.

notes.ko: All I did was 뒤에는 to가 있어도 없어도 됩니다.
notes.en: After All I did was, to is optional.

notes.ko: 분열문을 너무 자주 쓰면 문체가 과장되게 들릴 수 있어요.

All I did was let the team know.

trans.ko:
A: 이번 위기를 구한 사람이 누구야?
B: 바로 신입 직원이었어. 그녀의 빠른 판단이 우리를 구했어.
A: 그럼 너는 뭘 했어?
B: 나는 그냥 팀에 알린 것뿐이야.

lines.t: English uses cleft sentences to focus attention on the part you want to stress. It was ... that stresses a particular element, and What ... is stresses the core. These structures are especially effective in speeches and essays, but overuse makes the style heavy.

trans.ko: 영어는 분열문으로 강조하고 싶은 부분에 청중의 주의를 집중시킵니다. It was ... that은 특정 요소를, What ... is는 핵심을 강조합니다. 이런 구문은 연설과 에세이에서 특히 효과적이지만 너무 자주 쓰면 문체가 무거워집니다.

items.passage:

A question of trust
The crux of this affair is not a lack of information but a collapse of trust. What citizens demand is not an apology but responsible action. That is precisely what the government must realise.

prompt.ko: 분열문과 의사분열문을 사용해 어떤 사건에서 가장 중요했던 것을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write four sentences about what mattered most in an event, using cleft and pseudo-cleft sentences.

task.model: What impressed me most that day was the team's calm. It was a colleague's short suggestion that changed the situation. All I did was back that suggestion. The reason we succeeded is that we trusted one another.

model_trans.ko: 그날 가장 인상 깊었던 것은 팀원들의 침착함이었어요. 상황을 바꾼 것은 한 동료의 짧은 제안이었어요. 내가 한 일이라고는 그 제안을 지지한 것뿐이에요. 우리가 성공한 이유는 서로를 믿었기 때문이에요.
model_trans.en: What impressed me most that day was the team's calm. It was a colleague's short suggestion that changed the situation. All I did was back that suggestion. The reason we succeeded is that we trusted one another.
